description: AccountFactory.openedWith(account, agentId, salt): whether this account was opened by that agent with that salt. Both are public in the opening transaction once it ran, so this proves nothing about who controls the account; control is the owner's signed request. The salt goes to Mercatura's RPC provider inside the call.

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

salt.description: The salt the account was opened with.

name: verify_account
title: Factor accounts: which agent opened an account
